worldcombat.skill.reversal.summary: A last-ditch eruption: plant and gather your remaining strength, leap under the target and burst upward with a pillar of fighting energy that throws open everything in a ring around you. The closer to fainting, the heavier the blow and the wider the ring; it is the only member with an area, and the only one whose area grows with your wounds.
worldcombat.skill.reversal.use.0: Turn a low HP bar into one big counter-blow
worldcombat.skill.reversal.use.1: Throw open everything that has surrounded you
worldcombat.skill.reversal.use.2: Reckless form: gamble on a heavy hit
worldcombat.skill.reversal.description.0: The burst deals about %1$s contact damage to every enemy in the ring; the closer you are to fainting the heavier the burst. Defence, type match-up and criticals settle per target.
worldcombat.skill.reversal.description.1: Plant for %1$s ticks (interruptible — nothing happens if interrupted), then leap up to %2$s blocks along your aim at %3$s blocks per tick to get under the target.
worldcombat.skill.reversal.description.2: The landing throws open a ring about %1$s blocks wide; every enemy in it is shoved outward about %2$s blocks, and the leap contacts with a %3$s block hit radius.
worldcombat.skill.reversal.reckless.on: Reckless form: a further boost to power, but every landed hit costs you %1$s of your maximum health in recoil, which may drop you while hurt.
worldcombat.skill.reversal.reckless.off: Not reckless: no recoil; power follows the current formula.
worldcombat.skill.reversal.timing: Cast within %1$s blocks; after %2$s ticks of planting it costs %4$s PP, then %3$s seconds of recovery and a %5$s second cooldown from commit.
worldcombat.skill.reversal.preference.re: On: a further boost to power, but every landed hit costs you 8% of your maximum health in recoil, which may drop you while hurt and may push your next burst higher; Off: no recoil.
worldcombat.skill.reversal.preference.ai: Beyond this distance it closes in instead of leaping. Larger values chase harder.
When your health ratio is not above this value the move becomes a primary option that outranks other attacks and scales further with your wounds; lower it so only greater danger prioritises it.
On: raise priority further when the target is below about a third health. Off: it only competes as an ordinary melee option.
On: it will leave its station under a hold order to burst. Off: it only bursts when the target is already in reach.
